indications.description: Treatment of advanced salivary gland cancer.

treatment.schedule_summary: Doxorubicin 50 mg/m², cisplatin 50 mg/m² and cyclophosphamide 500 mg/m² on Day 1, repeated every 21 days for up to 6 cycles, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable side effects.
